$comment: FORM P5 admission, written 2026-11-18 after a per-keyword audit of both apps' models, the probes and the bundle text (docs/content/authoring-for-ai.yml).

declarative.why: says which roles land where (for), the first screen (home), the entries (navigation, with icon/badge expressions) and the look (device, theme); no ordering, no logic

notLower.why: where a signed-in user lands is decided by the login shell (/api/x/me picks the first experience whose `for` matches a role); a function or expression cannot route a login, and the mobile manifest/icons are generated from device+theme

twice.note: experience.theme and experience.backOffice: ride-hailing `dispatch` and dsl-conformance-max `warehouse` (the dsl-conformance-max use was added 2026-11-18 for this record)

enforced.note: probe 19 proves /x/<exp>/ and /api/x/me follow `for`; probe 22 (22-experience-manifest.json) proves device -> installable manifest; ExperienceValidationTest rejects bad for/home/navigation/device at model time; theme and backOffice are read by the client (experience-client.test.mjs) but have no server-side probe

taught.bundleLine: `experiences[]` says who lands where ... Experience extras: `title`, `device` (`mobile` = bottom tab bar, max 5 entries, installable; `web`; `both`), `theme` (`"dark"`), `backOffice:true` (also link the generated back office), navigation `icon` and `badge`
